findings.title: Ledger confirms unauthorized implant in one reseller-distributed hardware wallet; extent of reported drains remains unverified
findings.observation: On Oct 10 Ledger Support confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in one affected customer's device sold through reseller CryptoBilis; the reseller paused sales. The broader loss estimates ($86m-$94m), affected wallet counts, and causality for every reported drain are not verified by Ledger. Ledger states its own infrastructure and services show no evidence of compromise.
findings.hypothesis: A verified supply-chain security event may temporarily alter cross-asset realized volatility, stablecoin transfer behavior and exchange deposits, but provides no reliable standalone directional edge.
findings.mechanism: Security concerns may prompt affected users to migrate funds or transfer to exchanges; these effects could change flows and liquidity without predicting price direction.
findings.exact_rule_or_model_spec: RESEARCH_ONLY_SECURITY_EVENT_STUDY_V1: freeze event timestamp at first official Ledger Support statement; compute pre-event 24h baseline and post-event 1h/6h/24h windows for BTC/ETH/TRX; compare to matched non-event controls by UTC hour, day-of-week and market-volatility regime; require positive net benefit after fees and slippage and independent confirmation of any hypothesized transfer-flow anomaly; never trade on headline alone.
required_data: Primary official Ledger statements and timestamp
Verified on-chain netflows with entity attribution and non-duplicated wallet movements
findings.transaction_cost_implications: During event shocks, spreads and slippage may widen. Evaluate baseline, 1.5x and 2x execution costs; avoid stale on-chain data or retroactively tagged addresses.
findings.falsification_criteria: REJECT if matched-control abnormal return/volatility/flow effects are not statistically or economically significant, if timestamps or wallet attribution are uncertain, or if post-cost future-only shadow results do not improve baseline.
contradictions: Third-party losses and address counts differ and may double count transfers.
A confirmed implant in one device does not establish a platform-wide Ledger compromise.
The news may have been priced in before the official confirmation; event-time leakage is material.

social_scout_summary: No independently verifiable, materially new strategy/algorithm thread beyond the already staged funding-depth hypothesis was found; promotional PnL claims were not promoted.
news_scout_summary: One material newly corroborated security finding. Previously reported ETF/liquidation developments, Oct 3 HYPE AQAv2 and Oct 10 XMR KuCoin suspension were deduplicated; conflicting APT unlock calendar estimates were not promoted.
